headline: For the exact three disjoint normalized uniform-bank family with nonzero spectrum {1,1,-1}, the entire output density converges uniformly to the isotropic Gaussian quadratic-form density as all three bank sizes diverge, uniformly over every spectral rotation; consequently the global density norm converges uniformly to 3sqrt(2), including non-aligned two-sheet geometry.

main_result.family: Y_j=m_j^{-1/2} sum_k U_jk with physical U_jk~Unif[-1/2,1/2], R_m^T R_m=I, A_{m,O}=R_m O^T diag(1,1,-1) O R_m^T

required_source_applied.application: Completed Theorem F is applied to the actual physical spectral frame V=R_m O^T. Exact row leverage 1/m_j<=1/2 yields an integrable uniform characteristic-function majorant, which upgrades CLT weak convergence to uniform convergence of the whole output density and excludes hidden off-tip spikes.

partner_applied.application: Its global two-heavy/one-Gaussian lightlike ceiling C_2H1G=4.109270566451296...<3sqrt(2) and finite-bank transfer are applied to the exact (m1,m2,m3)=(1,1,m) boundary family, complementing the all-diffuse all-rotation theorem.

unresolved_implication: A sharp-constant witness inside the three-bank architecture must retain a bounded/intermediate bank along a subsequence and avoid the canonical lightlike (1,1,m) edge; still unpaid are genuinely non-aligned finite/intermediate bank configurations, rough non-log-concave bank laws, shared or multiscale macroscopic rows, and extra active spectrum.
next_step: Analyze the compact boundary with one bounded bank and two diffuse banks for arbitrary non-aligned B, seeking either a strict <=3sqrt(2) ceiling or a source-valid overshoot; do not use generic two-sheet X-ray or post-rotation independence.
